conclusions: All72 PNGs were opened individually at original detail, including every repeated blank SHA.
36 actual component frames show intact labels, correct RTL switch direction, selected/on output, and a complete disabled-selected comparison.
320px and English long labels wrap visibly without crop. Track/thumb remain inside the visible frame; the legal paint/hit extent is not proven from pixel inspection alone.
Apple content surface and its different host background remain distinct; visible text and controls lie fully inside the content surface, not cut by that transition.
No independent keyboard-focus contour is established by these click/tap environment frames; absence of a keyboard ring in such a frame is not a focus defect.
Native failure statuses remain unchanged:35failed,1interrupted,247not-run. Geometry premise failure and lack of new visible product issues do not convert this run into acceptance.
All72 are baseline-ineligible diagnostic evidence. A new Switch-2 candidate must complete its own matrix and independent visual review; old failure images cannot substitute.
